content:
200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully added the scanner to the scanner group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to add scanners to scanner groups.
— 404
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified scanner or scanner group.
— 409
Returned if you attempt to add a scanner to a scanner group that the scanner is already a member of.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management fails to add the scanner to the scanner group.
